title: Supporters Club - FC Schalke 04
content: This new ruling was determined during the 2017 General Assembly meeting to change the contribution regulations: “Members of a registered FC Schalke 04 Supporters Club are eligible for their first year free as an ‘Official Member’ at FC Schalke 04.”. The free year is the calendar year of the membership application. The first membership fee will then be calculated in January of the following year as an annual subscription. For a supporters club to register for free at FC Schalke 04, there are only a few requirements:. The contact person for all relevant fan club questions is the Fan Affairs section (fanbelange@schalke04.de) to whom the completed PDF registration form can be sent. Following registration, the supporters club will be assigned a specific registration number. This number must be included in subsequent Membership applications in order to claim the initial free year. The registration is independent of the membership in the Schalke Fan Club Association (SFCV). **FC Gelsenkirchen-Schalke 04 e.V.**.

FC Gelsenkirchen-Schalke 04 e.V., commonly known as FC Schalke 04, is one of the most successful and well-known football clubs in Germany with seven German championships, five successes in the German Cup and the victory in the 1997 UEFA Cup. As a registered association, the Royal Blues delimit themselves from investor-funded and group-owned clubs and own unique and valuable selling points. FC Schalke 04 stands for the values of tradition, success and passion and is, with more than 150,000 members, one of the three largest clubs in Germany and one of the five largest in the world. The strategic expansion fields include digitization, internationalization, Esports and the construction project “Berger Feld.”​ As an attractive employer in the city of Gelsenkirchen as well as in the region, the club is an important local figurehead and complies its social responsibility with its own foundation Schalke hilft!. title: FC Schalke 04 celebrate reaching 200,000 members - Fußball
content: FC Gelsenkirchen-Schalke 04 e.V. have reached the 200,000 member mark! The FC Gelsenkirchen-Schalke 04 e.V. supervisory board has agreed to a long-term contract extension with Christina Rühl-Hamers, as announced on Friday (5/9). # FC Schalke 04 celebrate reaching 200,000 members. Susanne from Gelsenkirchen serves as a representative of all the members of the Royal Blue family who have taken steps to express their loyalty and connection to the club in the form of an official membership. “200,000 members is a new level. FC Schalke 04 are known around the globe for having passionate fans who have supported the club week in and week out, across generations and over the decades,” said Matthias Tillmann, CEO of FC Schalke 04, on behalf of the club’s board. This backing is of immense value to FC Schalke 04, and the club extends its heartfelt thanks to every member.”. ### Frank Baumann appointed as FC Schalke 04’s new board member for sport.
